description: What tools/actions.py may bind an action to on this platform. Read only by Python tooling at build time; the engine never sees this file. Derived from engine/src/platform/ps2/Input.cpp and Platform.cpp: the pad mask passes through unmodified (m_pads[port].buttons = ~data->btns), so every DualShock 2 button is a real, distinct source. PlatformCapability::AnalogTriggers is false, so L2/R2 exist only as digital buttons, never as trigger sources.
